venue.name: Tourism Tofino
venue.description: Tourism Tofino is Tofino's official not-for-profit destination marketing and management organization, governed by its members and contracted by the District of Tofino to provide visitor services. It runs the Tofino Visitor Centre on the Pacific Rim Highway by Cox Bay, where a Visitor Services team gives out maps and local information and sells Parks Canada passes, plus a seasonal information tent at 380 Campbell Street in July and August. The centre has accessible washrooms, free WiFi, picnic tables, a water refill station, a gift shop of work by local artists and carvers, and a community meeting room that can be requested. It publishes no tour, workshop or other offering of its own for school or daycare groups, so it is an information stop rather than a place to bring a class.
venue.address: 1426 Pacific Rim Highway, Box 1140, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0, Canada

facility_notes.wheelchair_accessible: The Tofino Visitor Centre building has numerous accessibility features including two beach wheelchairs that are available by reservation.
facility_notes.bus_parking: Bus stop (Tofino Express, West Coast Transit and the Tofino Free Shuttle in summer)

venue.hours_notes: July & August - 8:30 am - 6:00 pm PST | September to June - 9:30 am - 5:00 pm PST. Holiday hours: Dec 24 & 31 - 9:30-4. Closed Dec 25 & January 1.
venue.seasonal_notes: A seasonal Visitor Information tent is set up in town in July and August at 380 Campbell Street, in the parking lot next to the Tofino Theatre, open 10:30 am - 3:30 pm.

gaps: Tourism Tofino is a destination marketing organisation, not a field trip venue. Its own site describes no tour, workshop, talk or group visit for children at the visitor centre, so no program is recorded.
the venues and activities listed across this site belong to other businesses and organisations, and were deliberately not extracted here
a site search for 'school group' and for 'field trip' returns only other businesses' listings and blog posts, nothing run by Tourism Tofino itself
the visitor centre has a bookable community meeting room, but the site gives no capacity, no cost, no minimum age and no indication it is offered to children's groups
the email address on the visitor centre and contact pages is hidden behind JavaScript and could not be read, so no booking email is recorded
no admission price is published for the visitor centre, and it is not stated whether entry is free
no youngest age, capacity or lead time is published, because there is nothing to book
an indoor lunch space is not described; the amenities list mentions picnic tables only, and it is not stated whether a group may use them
rain backup is not described beyond the building itself
car and bus parking at the visitor centre are not described anywhere on the site; the amenities list mentions a bus stop for transit services
the site says the building has 'numerous accessibility features' but does not say the entrance or interior is step-free, so the accessibility flag is left unanswered
